svg.title: yolo-labz gremlin character sheet
svg.desc: Front, three-quarter and side views of the head, the full body, the eye and mouth rules and the five states.

svg.text: 1 head unit (HU) = ear to ear = 16 u = the mark box. Eyes and brow are the mark's. Skin is the character and is never recoloured.
